normalized.result: Yes, that makes the distinction clear. When my reading list is empty, "You're all caught up" with the reassurance that the bookmarks are still safe — and the Read later count sitting at zero — tells me I've finished my reading, not that I've lost anything. And clicking back to "All bookmarks" brings my four saved links right back, so I can see plainly that the reading list being empty is separate from my collection, which is all still there. That message feels right.
